title: Cardiopulmonary exercise test
what: You pedal a bike or walk on a treadmill while wearing a mask. The equipment checks how your heart works and how much oxygen you use.
why: When the cause of shortness of breath is unclear, before surgery, for heart and lung conditions, or to find a safe level of exercise.
duration: usually 45 to 60 minutes including setup; the exercise itself takes 8 to 12 minutes
tell_doctor: All your medicines. Your doctor will say if anything needs to be stopped
If you get chest pain with exercise
If your joints hurt and it is hard to walk or pedal

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: A light meal 2 to 3 hours before the test. Do not come hungry, and do not eat a big meal.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: No hard workouts or alcohol. On the day of the test, you usually skip coffee and do not smoke. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop anything on your own. If your doctor gives you a plan, follow it.

steps: ECG stickers are put on your chest and a blood pressure cuff on your arm
A mask is put on your face. You breathe through it
First, readings are taken at rest
You start pedaling or walking, and the effort slowly goes up
You keep going until you are tired or the doctor stops you
After the test, you rest until your pulse settles
feel: The mask feels strange at first
By the end, you feel very tired and out of breath, like after a hard workout
Your legs may still be sore the next day
after: Sit for 10 to 15 minutes before you leave
Reading the results usually takes from a few hours to a few days
Avoid heavy exercise for the rest of the day
red_flags: Chest pain, dizziness, or not getting enough air during the test: tell the doctor right away
Chest pain or fainting after the test: call emergency services

faq.a: To see how your heart and lungs work at their maximum. But you will be stopped if it becomes unsafe.

faq.q: How is this different from a normal treadmill test?
faq.a: Besides the ECG, it measures your breathing and gas exchange. This helps show what limits you: the heart, the lungs, or the muscles.

reminders.text: Exercise test tomorrow. Bring sportswear and shoes. Have a light meal 2 to 3 hours before.
